title: Characterization of accepted configuration checks
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $s$ be a natural number. A bit string $w$ satisfies the acceptance check for $x$ and window radius $s$ if and only if it is the encoded word of some configuration $C$ on input $x$ whose work-tape heads and nonblank cells lie within distance $s$ of the origin, with $C$ halted and its output exactly the one-bit string $[1]$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet
